name: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half-marathon and multi-distance race held November 22, 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled for November 22, 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City / Clark, Pampanga, Philippines. Organized by SMOKE10 Events, the race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to seasoned half-marathoners. Registration for the event is currently open.
